scope: Only round-289 named terminal-publication, complete-interruption-archive, exact-event-prefix, and failure-binding findings. Engine, binary, fixtures, W7.1 lifecycle, scorer, and containment wrappers are unchanged from candidate 2.

review_finding_disposition.resolution: A factored terminal publisher reads the strict summary verdict, writes it into the normal manifest, blocks termination through publication/fsync, and validates the completed triplet. Validation requires the exact schema, all bound component fields, manifest/summary verdict equality, exact raw-row count, and an artifact map equal to the full regular-file inventory.

Active expected bindings persist beside active rows. The failure manifest records each expected/observed mismatch explicitly while binding the observed full artifact inventory. Termination remains blocked from before parse through row and binding publication, verified from inside the parser callback.

Each candidate event first must fullmatch either no prefix or the exact MMDD HH:MM:SS logger prefix, then the normalized payload must fullmatch the exact store/hit form or equal the exact activation/skip marker. Arbitrary prefixes, suffixes, concatenations, substituted values, and extras fail.
